product_one_liner.value: Rasayel is a WhatsApp sales platform for B2B teams that tracks conversations, automates follow-ups, and synchronizes customer interactions with their CRM.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes conversation tracking, automated follow-ups, and CRM synchronization for sales teams. Its Cleo announcement explicitly identifies B2B teams selling over WhatsApp as the audience: https://www.rasayel.io/ and https://learn.rasayel.io/en/blog/qualification-ai-agent.

pricing_page.notes: Rasayel has a public pricing page presenting its plans: https://rasayel.io/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Rasayel's homepage presents customer testimonials attributed to FactorialHR and Casita, with links to their success stories: https://rasayel.io/. | named_customers.0: The homepage testimonial identifies Joao Arthur Ferreira as Global Sales Operations Specialist at FactorialHR: https://rasayel.io/. | named_customers.1: The homepage attributes a customer testimonial to Casita and links its success story: https://rasayel.io/.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 15 employees, which maps directly to 11-20: https://platform.tracxn.com/a/d/company/60fb54e39d44921d99865582/rasayel. The official team page also lists 12 named staff, consistent with that band: https://www.rasayel.io/about.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Craft identifies Cork as Rasayel's headquarters city: https://craft.co/rasayel. | hq_country: Craft identifies Cork, Ireland as headquarters: https://craft.co/rasayel.

founded_year.notes: Seedcamp's company profile explicitly gives 2022 as the founding year: https://talent.seedcamp.com/companies/rasayel.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed blog index contains WhatsApp business guides, sales and marketing tutorials, product content, and customer stories—not two engineer-authored articles about building Rasayel: https://learn.rasayel.io/en/blog.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation contains multiple sections and articles covering the shared inbox, WhatsApp Business, automations, integrations, and Support AI: https://docs.rasayel.io/ and http://docs.rasayel.io/support-ai-assistant.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The verified careers board lists Senior Software Engineer and no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science job title. AI-related responsibilities in a generic engineering role do not meet the requested title rule: https://careerspage.io/rasayel.

model_provider.notes: No underlying model or AI provider was identified after reviewing the Support AI documentation, Cleo announcement, security policy, and privacy-policy service-provider disclosures. Those pages describe Rasayel's AI generically: http://docs.rasayel.io/support-ai-assistant, https://learn.rasayel.io/en/blog/qualification-ai-agent, https://docs.rasayel.io/security-policy, and https://docs.rasayel.io/privacy. The value is therefore unknown.

compliance_certs.notes: The readable security policy names none of the five requested certifications: https://docs.rasayel.io/security-policy. The privacy policy discusses GDPR legal bases and rights without explicitly claiming certification or compliance, and its PCI certification statement belongs to Stripe, not Rasayel: https://docs.rasayel.io/privacy.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The target-specific funding profiles identify one Seed round, dated February 2022: https://wellfound.com/company/rasayel/funding and https://tracxn.com/d/companies/rasayel/__FDHIBNoFO8Rhs4AYMsKYd_G9AJr_lU_yJO-OKgXJtTs/funding-and-investors. | funding_date: Wellfound dates the only listed Seed round to February 2022; PitchBook independently lists 01-Feb-2022. Normalized to the requested format, this is 2022-02: https://wellfound.com/company/rasayel/funding and https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/507248-38. | funding_amount_usd: The February 2022 Seed round is explicitly labeled 'Undisclosed amount', so no USD funding amount can be supplied: https://wellfound.com/company/rasayel/funding. The displayed valuation placeholder is not a funding amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest target-specific funding history lists only the February 2022 Seed round, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025. Tracxn's funding page was updated October 17, 2026: https://wellfound.com/company/rasayel/funding and https://tracxn.com/d/companies/rasayel/__FDHIBNoFO8Rhs4AYMsKYd_G9AJr_lU_yJO-OKgXJtTs/funding-and-investors.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The verified careers board lists Senior Software Engineer, with no SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account-executive opening: https://careerspage.io/rasayel.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest dated launch-type changelog entry is Automated HubSpot property updates on April 28, 2026, before the six-month window beginning May 9, 2026. The reviewed blog provided no newer qualifying launch: https://docs.rasayel.io/en/changelog.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The complete, small team page was checked. Its only C-level leaders are cofounders Tarek Khalil, CEO, and Mohamed Elbadwihi, COO; it lists no VP or leadership appointment/departure within the requested window: https://www.rasayel.io/about. This is a page-based negative rather than an explicit statement that no changes occurred.
